title: Bug report with replay evidence
tagline: The kitsoki-lineage case — a bug report carrying opt-in rrweb replay and network summary, with privacy review before submission.

scenarios: The kitsoki-lineage case — a bug report carrying opt-in rrweb replay and network summary, with privacy review before submission.

rail.decision: User hits an issue in a host app embedding the widget; triggers the reporter (floating, chromeless trigger).

inspector.headline: User hits an issue in a host app embedding the widget; triggers the reporter (floating, chromeless trigger).
inspector.meaning: A reviewed, privacy-scrubbed feedback bundle lands in the configured sink with a reproducible anchor trace, ready for triage without a bespoke reporter per host app.

steps: User hits an issue in a host app embedding the widget; triggers the reporter (floating, chromeless trigger).
Widget captures an anchor at the trigger point (producer-owned) plus an optional rrweb replay clip and network summary, opt-in per host policy.
Review step surfaces the privacy manifest before submission — unclassified fields block submit; raw capture never leaves the device pre-review.
User adds prose and picks a kind (bug is one of several, not privileged) and submits; a client-side idempotency key dedupes accidental double-submits.
Bundle routes to a configured sink (local/bundle/dry-run in v0.1; GitHub is a later parity follow-on, never required).
